title: Battushig D Possible NDE 9027
content: My parents divorced in 1996. For 10 years after that, my life was a mess. I divorced in 2002, left my wife and daughter, and was drunk most of the time until 2006. I was diagnosed with a bad gallbladder and acute pancreatitis attack. The doctors treated me for 2 weeks before the surgery. Right before they took me to surgery room, all I thought was that I had enough of this life. I had nothing to regret, and I thanked my parents in my mind. I felt ready if I was to die that day. I was wondering if anyone else could see the smoke or fog? It was like I was in a pitch dark, outer space-like environment. Yet, I wondered if there was a light somewhere? I don't know. I was floating with peace of mind and nothing to worry about. My mind worked faster than anything, yet I couldn't feel my legs or hands. The operation lasted for about 4 hours. They woke me up by slapping my cheeks while I was in intensive care. I spent 6 months in the hospital with a cut-open belly and suffering from this sharp pain. Somehow, I knew I had to fight for my life and get up and walk. Everything in my life changed after I got out of the hospital. I got married again, and have two beautiful children. We're living peacefully. I always feel thankful for everything to my ancestors, to somebody or something. I appreciate everything in this world; the flowers, wind, rain; the sun, people and gods. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: December 2006 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Surgery-related Life threatening event, but not clinical death acute pancreatitis surgery How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? No I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal I was able to think faster than usual At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I'm not sure but I think it was when I blacked out on the surgery bed Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. There was no time Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I tried hard to see in the dark, but everything looked foggy. It might have been someone near me Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I was deaf. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? Yes It was like bright fog or smoke. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Some unfamiliar and strange place It was like outer space or the cosmos What emotions did you feel during the experience? complete peace Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Do not know Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes What is your religion now? Other or several faiths shamanism Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes everything is connected to everything During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists. I know I still exist Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life After some years, I had a dream standing outside at night while watching the stars with someone who I could not see but he was there beside me. We jumped and in a blink of an eye, we were floating in outer space watching colorful Earth. Then in a matter of second, I was watching the moon in awe of its grey, dark surface. We then were diving faster and faster into the dark endless void of the moon. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes Have you ever shared this experience with others? No Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real The body I'm in is just like the clothes I am wearing What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real

arrival.other_being_detail: He reported sensing a presence/being but did not identify it.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described as a pitch-dark, outer space/cosmos-like environment with fog/smoke-like brightness.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Woke up in intensive care; reported being awakened by slapping on cheeks.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Acute pancreatitis/gallbladder surgery; reported as life-threatening but not clinical death.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Prior: 'Do not know'; after: 'Other or several faiths' (shamanism).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Dark outer-space/cosmos-like realm with fog/smoke; sensed presence/being; no tunnel, no OBE, no boundary, no life review.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: He described blacking out on the surgery bed and then being in a dark, foggy outer-space-like environment with peace and heightened cognition; then awakening in ICU.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported being 'deaf' during the experience; described an unearthly light as 'bright fog or smoke' in a pitch-dark cosmos-like environment.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “The body I'm in is just like the clothes I am wearing.”
